objective: Independently rebuild M287 from the ep35 checkpoint and all 100 frozen FC1 payloads without importing the producer analyzer, then separate exact arithmetic opportunity from executable hardware performance.

required_attacks.checkpoint: load the model object independently and enumerate all twelve FC1 weights
required_attacks.payloads: rehash and decode exactly 100 binary FC1 payloads totaling 112,213,979 active source events
required_attacks.bit_order: implement LITTLE_WITHIN_BYTE without importing the producer and show a big-endian canary changes weighted DSE while preserving total popcount
required_attacks.stage3: prove the two stage3 FC1 weights exist in the checkpoint but have no binary payload and stay excluded
required_attacks.quantization: repeat symmetric per-output-row INT8 round-nearest quantization with range [-127,127]
required_attacks.predicate: recompute max-within-destination-group for sizes 4/8/16/32/96 and beta 0/8/16/24/32/48/64/80/96
required_attacks.beta_zero: prove baseline equals kept at every group size and module
required_attacks.activity_weighting: weight each source/group predicate by its frozen per-channel activity, not uniform or static-pair share
required_attacks.amdahl: independently recompute the 620,302,905/118,370,114 producer sensitivity, then prevent the ten binary-module ratio from scaling the 17,474,490 cycles of the two excluded stage3 modules
required_attacks.claim_hygiene: reject interpreting ideal task compaction or Amdahl sensitivity as executable cycles, system speedup or accuracy
required_attacks.bound: classify beta times omitted-source-count as a conservative quantized INT8 accumulator-domain bound only
required_attacks.wrong_sha: tampered input identity must fail before checkpoint/payload replay and create no output
